                                      Full job description

                                      Overview
                                      Are you passionate about driving brand growth and engaging audiences through innovative digital strategies? We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Digital Marketing Specialist to lead our online marketing initiatives. In this role, you will craft compelling campaigns, optimize digital channels, and analyze performance metrics to maximize our reach and impact. Join us to shape the future of our digital presence and deliver measurable results that elevate our brand to new heights! This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to influence a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where your creativity and analytical skills will thrive.

                                      Duties

                                      • Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive digital marketing strategies across multiple platforms including social media, search engines, email, and content management systems.
                                      • Manage SEO campaigns utilizing SEO tools and conduct keyword research to improve organic search rankings.
                                      • Execute paid advertising campaigns using Google Ads (formerly Google AdWords) and Facebook Advertising to drive traffic, conversions, and ROI.
                                      • Optimize website performance through conversion rate optimization techniques, A/B testing, and analytics insights.
                                      • Create engaging content for various channels including blogs, social media posts, email marketing campaigns, and landing pages using copywriting skills and graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite.
                                      • Monitor website analytics with Google Analytics and other analytics tools to track KPIs, generate reports, and refine marketing tactics accordingly.
                                      • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on e-commerce initiatives, ensuring seamless content management via WordPress or other CMS platforms.
                                      • Implement marketing automation workflows to nurture leads and improve customer engagement in B2B or B2C contexts.
                                      • Stay updated on the latest trends in digital marketing, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), performance marketing, and emerging tools like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL for advanced data analysis or website customization.

                                      Qualifications

                                      • Proven experience managing digital marketing campaigns with a strong understanding of SEO tools, SEM strategies, and social media management platforms.
                                      • Proficiency in Google Ads (Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, Google Analytics, and marketing automation software.
                                      • Skilled in content creation including copywriting, graphic design (Adobe Photoshop & Creative Suite), and video editing is a plus.
                                      • Technical knowledge of HTML, Claude Code, Wordpress, CSS, JavaScript, GoHighLevel SQL for website optimization or custom integrations.
                                      • Familiarity with content management systems such as WordPress or similar platforms.
                                      • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data for performance optimization.
                                      • Excellent communication skills with an eye for detail and a passion for innovative digital solutions.
                                      • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media or related field preferred; relevant certifications in SEO or Google Ads are advantageous. Join us as a Digital Marketing Manager to lead impactful campaigns that captivate audiences worldwide! Your expertise will help shape our brand’s digital journey while advancing your career in a vibrant environment committed to innovation and excellence.

                                      Pay: $40,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

                                      Application Question(s):

                                      • How many years of experience do you have managing paid digital marketing campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads)?
                                      • How many of the following channels have you personally owned and managed: Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, email marketing, organic social?
                                      • Do you have digital marketing experience in the aesthetics, med spa, luxury wellness, beauty, or premium healthcare industry? If yes, please specify which.
                                      • What is the largest monthly paid media budget you have personally managed? Please provide a dollar amount.
                                      • This role is hybrid with 3 days per week in Beverly Hills, CA. Are you currently located in the greater Los Angeles area?
                                      • How many physical locations have you managed digital marketing for simultaneously?
                                      • Describe the most impactful digital marketing campaign you have personally built and what measurable results it drove. Please be specific.

                                      Work Location: Remote
